summary: Xining Caojiabao International Airport is the principal aviation gateway to Qinghai Province in northwestern China, situated on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau at an elevation of approximately 2,179 meters (7,149 feet), making it one of the higher-altitude commercial airports in the world. Located in Huzhu Tu Autonomous County about 30 km east of Xining city center, it replaced the older Xining Airport and handles flights connecting the region to major domestic hubs such as Beijing, Shanghai, and Chengdu, as well as select international destinations. The airport plays a strategic role in supporting tourism to the Tibetan Plateau, including access to Qinghai Lake and onward travel to Tibet.
faqs:
Q: How far is Xining Caojiabao Airport from the city center of Xining?
A: The airport is located approximately 30 km (19 miles) east of downtown Xining, with typical journey times of 45-60 minutes by road depending on traffic.

Q: Why is altitude a concern when flying into Xining?
A: At over 2,100 meters elevation, passengers may experience mild altitude effects such as shortness of breath or fatigue; staying hydrated and avoiding strenuous activity upon arrival is recommended.

Q: Which airlines operate from Xining Caojiabao Airport?
A: The airport is served by numerous Chinese carriers including China Eastern, Air China, China Southern, Xiamen Airlines, and Tibet Airlines, along with seasonal international charter services.

Q: Does the airport offer direct international flights?
A: Limited scheduled international services are available, primarily to nearby Asian destinations; most international travelers connect through major hubs such as Beijing or Chengdu.
transport_tips: The airport is connected to Xining city center via the Xinning Expressway, with airport shuttle buses, taxis, and ride-hailing services readily available outside the terminal. A taxi ride to central Xining typically costs around 100-150 RMB and takes 45-60 minutes. Several long-distance buses also depart from the airport area to other cities in Qinghai Province.
local_tip: If you have a layover or early arrival, ask your hotel in advance about oxygen enrichment services or portable oxygen canisters, as many accommodations in Xining cater to travelers adjusting to the high-altitude environment.
